name: smart-upload-engine-frontend
description: Static dashboard for the Smart Upload Engine. No build step is required to run the app: index.html, app.js, and style.css are served directly by the FastAPI backend as static files. This package.json exists so the frontend can be optionally extended with tooling (linters, bundlers) later.

scripts.lint: echo 'No build step required. Edit static/app.js and static/style.css directly.'
